title: Pre-Migration: Extract Shared Protocols Module
description: Extract shared protocols from services layer to independent protocols module. This resolves ARCH-004 tight coupling issue where services layer and agents layer share protocols. Must be completed before TypeScript migration to enable clean interface definitions.

services/ and agents/ import from shared protocols module

No functional changes - behavior remains identical
